External links for this lesson, checked to load on 2026-11-13. Quoted regulatory and program text in
the lesson comes from the local copies in `sources/`, not from these pages.

- **[Recipient Epidemiology and Donor Evaluation Study (REDS) Program | NHLBI, NIH](https://www.nhlbi.nih.gov/science/recipient-epidemiology-and-donor-evaluation-study-reds-program)**
  — NHLBI's own page for the program. Use it first when anyone mentions a "new" REDS phase: check
  here for any later phase name before relying on one. Verified loading via `curl` on 2026-11-13
  (HTTP 200). This lesson cites its facts only from the sources listed below, not from this page.

- **[Josephson et al., REDS-IV-P program paper (PubMed Central full text)](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC9353062/)**
  — the peer-reviewed description of the program: lineage, governance bodies, hubs, DCC, CTLS and
  the V2V database. Read Sections 1 to 3. It is research description, not regulation. Verified
  loading via `curl` on 2026-11-13 (HTTP 200; the page returned an empty `<title>` to `curl`).

- **[NIH RePORTER](https://reporter.nih.gov/)** — search "Recipient Epidemiology and Donor
  Evaluation Study" to see the 2026 contract records yourself and re-check who holds what.
  Verified loading via `curl` on 2026-11-13 (HTTP 200; title "RePORT ⟩ RePORTER").

- **[NIH Data Management and Sharing Policy](https://grants.nih.gov/policy-and-compliance/policy-topics/sharing-policies/dms)**
  — NIH's landing page for the policy whose Section III scope names contracts. Module 4 goes deep.
  Verified loading via `curl` on 2026-11-13 (HTTP 200).

- **[Cornell LII: 45 CFR Part 46, Protection of Human Subjects](https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/45/part-46)**
  — the Common Rule, current text. Use it to see that human-subjects rules exist and where the
  definitions live before module 3. Verified loading via `curl` on 2026-11-13 (HTTP 200).

- **[Acquisition.GOV: FAR Part 35, Research and Development Contracting](https://www.acquisition.gov/far/part-35)**
  — general federal rules for how the government buys research and development by contract. Use it
  for the contract-versus-grant idea only. It is not a description of any REDS contract's terms.
  Verified loading via `curl` on 2026-11-13 (HTTP 200).

- **[BioLINCC: RADAR study page](https://biolincc.nhlbi.nih.gov/studies/radar)** — NHLBI's biospecimen
  and data repository, the kind of place the paper says earlier REDS data were shared through. Use
  it to see what downstream sharing looks like (module 4). Verified loading via `curl` on
  2026-11-13 (HTTP 200; empty `<title>` to `curl`). I did not confirm that this particular study
  is a REDS-III record.

- **[Regulatory landscape orientation](../../../foundations/regulatory-landscape-orientation/index.qmd)**
  and **[BECS in the pipeline](../../blood-center-operations/becs-in-the-pipeline/index.qmd)** — the
  earlier lessons this one builds on: the tiers, and the BECS records the extract must not touch.

- **[NIH VideoCast: NHLBI and OASH State of the Science in Transfusion Medicine Symposium 2022 (Day 2)](https://videocast.nih.gov/watch=46109)**
  — NIH's own recording of an NHLBI symposium on transfusion-medicine research priorities, the field
  REDS works in. A long symposium, not a REDS explainer, and not embeddable here; no YouTube video on
  REDS governance was found. Verified loading via `curl` on 2026-11-13 (HTTP 200; page title checked).

## Keep learning

Not official sources, and not authority for any regulatory claim.

- **[BBGuy Essentials 098: Kleinman and Josephson on REDS-IV-P (transcript, PDF)](https://bbguy.org/pdf/BBGE_098_Kleinman-Josephson_Transcript.pdf)**
  (Blood Bank Guy podcast) — a conversation with a program leader on the REDS-IV-P program. Good
  for the scientific motivation your medical director will describe. The search result that
  surfaced it described it as an interview with Steve Kleinman and Cassandra Josephson; I have not
  read the transcript in full. Verified loading via `curl` on 2026-11-13 (HTTP 200; PDF, no HTML
  title).

- **[Blood Bank Guy podcast home](https://www.bbguy.org/)** (Blood Bank Guy, Joe Chaffin) — an
  ongoing transfusion-medicine podcast; browse it for episodes on research programs and
  transfusion-safety studies. Verified loading via `curl` on 2026-11-13 (HTTP 200; title "Blood Bank
  Guy - Essential Transfusion Medicine with Joe Chaffin").

- **[NIH Grants & Funding: Human Subjects Research](https://grants.nih.gov/policy-and-compliance/policy-topics/human-subjects)**
  (NIH, official but a policy-topic overview rather than regulation) — a plain-language starting
  point on how NIH treats human-subjects research, before module 3. Verified loading via `curl` on
  2026-11-13 (HTTP 200).

- **[BioLINCC home](https://biolincc.nhlbi.nih.gov/home/)** (NHLBI) — the repository's front door,
  for seeing how requesting shared NHLBI study data works. Verified loading via `curl` on
  2026-11-13 (HTTP 200; empty `<title>` to `curl`).
